issues.legal_issue: Whether the land identified in the title documents was the same land as the disputed property.
Whether the plaintiff proved legal title to the disputed property and, consequently, entitlement to possession.
Whether a plaintiff seeking title and possession must prove a better legal title, and cannot succeed merely because the defendants have not fully established their own title.
Whether the weakness of the defendants’ case can relieve the plaintiff of the burden to prove the facts supporting her claim.
